name: @factstack/ui-remix
description: Primary WebUI for FACTS. Built on Remix v3 (beta) — its own VDOM runtime, no React. Vite + JSX via the `remix/ui` subpath of the umbrella `remix` package (canonical entry; `@remix-run/ui` is the legacy standalone re-exported by `remix/ui` and on the way out). Two build targets: dev server (live re-analyze) and static (Netlify deploy, `factstack export`, VS Code webview).

scripts.build: vite build && tsx scripts/gen-fb-config.mjs && tsx scripts/generate-discovery.mjs && tsx scripts/inject-data.mjs && node scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs
scripts.build:static: vite build --mode static && tsx scripts/gen-fb-config.mjs && tsx scripts/generate-discovery.mjs && tsx scripts/inject-data.mjs && node scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs
scripts.deploy:cf: pnpm build:static && npx --yes wrangler@4 pages deploy dist --project-name factstack
